name: Justimon: Accel Arm
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] By returning 1 level 6 Digimon card without [Justimon: Accel Arm] in its name from this Digimon's digivolution cards to its owner's hand, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[When Attacking] If you have a Tamer in play, this Digimon can digivolve into a Digimon card with [Justimon] in its name other than [Justimon: Accel Arm] in your hand for a digivolution cost of 2, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
